about: RW5d P2 hostile-sketch corpus (G-SM11): the same programs in the sidecar (tests/test_sketch_hostile.py, tests/test_sketch_sandbox_review.py) and the desktop (sketchParity.test.ts, sketchSandboxReview.test.ts). cases: one program in the pinned engine (call: one read after init, or calls: a sequence; expect is the last read's); verify_cases: whole programs and the verifier's outcome (the sidecar runs them); worker_messages: requests the desktop's Worker must accept or refuse (the desktop runs them).

cases.name: every reach name is undefined
cases.code:
function init(){return 1} function view(){return {}}
function probes(){ var out = {}; ["fetch", "XMLHttpRequest", "WebSocket", "EventSource", "importScripts", "postMessage", "self", "window", "document", "navigator", "location", "indexedDB", "caches", "localStorage", "require", "process", "Deno", "Bun", "__TAURI__", "__TAURI_INTERNALS__", "__TAURI_IPC__", "ipc", "webkit", "chrome", "WebAssembly", "SharedArrayBuffer", "Atomics", "setTimeout", "setInterval", "queueMicrotask", "Promise", "Proxy", "RegExp", "Date", "performance", "crypto", "console", "print", "std", "os", "scriptArgs", "gc"].forEach(function (n) { out[n] = typeof globalThis[n]; }); out.mathRandom = typeof Math.random; return out; }

cases.name: the global object holds only the program
cases.code:
function init(){return 1} function view(){return {}}
function probes(){ return {keys: Object.getOwnPropertyNames(globalThis).filter(function (k) { return ['init','view','probes','rand'].indexOf(k) >= 0; })}; }

cases.name: an endless loop in view
cases.code:
function init(){return 1} function probes(){return {}}
function view(){ for (;;) {} }

cases.name: an endless loop that catches
cases.code:
function init(){return 1} function probes(){return {}}
function view(){ for (;;) { try { for (;;) {} } catch (e) {} } }

cases.name: deep recursion
cases.code:
function init(){return 1} function view(){return {}}
function probes(){ function f(n) { return f(n + 1) + 1; } return f(0); }

cases.code:
